_readme: Single source of truth for CV content. Every fact a tailored CV, cover letter or screening answer may claim MUST exist in this file first.
Created and maintained by the /onboard skill; edit by hand whenever your experience changes.
Copy to data/master_cv.json and replace every Alex Example value with your own. All content below is fictional.

Structure notes: 'profiles' holds one summary paragraph per job category; 'job_categories' controls section order and skill emphasis per category; 'experience' is keyed by employer slug; bullets carry 'versions' (short/medium/long) so the tailoring system can trade length for page fill without rewriting facts.

profiles._comment: One tailorable profile paragraph per job category, plus a default. The tailoring skills start from the closest match and adapt it to the JD.
profiles.default: Business Analyst with 3 years of experience at ExampleCorp in Toronto, specialising in operations analytics, reporting automation and stakeholder-facing process improvement. Strong SQL and Python skills combined with a track record of turning ambiguous business questions into decision-ready analysis.
profiles.bizops: Business operations analyst with 3 years at ExampleCorp supporting a 200-person services business. Owns the monthly KPI reporting cycle, automated recurring reports in Python to save 10+ hours a week, and led the process mapping work behind a customer onboarding redesign that cut turnaround time by 30%. Comfortable presenting to directors and translating messy operational questions into structured analysis.
profiles.data-analyst: Data analyst with 3 years of hands-on SQL and Python experience at ExampleCorp. Built and maintains 12 self-serve dashboards used by 30+ stakeholders, introduced data quality checks that halved reporting errors, and developed a demand forecasting model that improved staffing decisions. BSc Economics with a quantitative dissertation on retail price elasticity.
profiles.product-analyst: Analyst with 3 years at ExampleCorp working at the boundary of operations and product, gathering requirements from 30+ stakeholders, defining KPIs for new internal tools and validating impact after launch. Side projects include a personal budgeting web app and a football league statistics dashboard, both built end-to-end with Python and JavaScript.

experience._comment_structure: Keyed by a short employer slug. Each entry: company, title, title_variants, location, start_date, end_date, bullets. Every bullet needs text, tags, metrics (or null) and versions; 'note' is optional guidance for the tailoring system.
